channel.title: Dr. Caner Özyıldırım — Scientific Articles
channel.description: Evidence-based scientific essays and clinical reviews on metabolism, obesity etiology, and nutrition.

item.title: Is Sleep Poised to Become a Dietary Risk Factor?
item.description: Can inadequate sleep be classified as a dietary risk factor? Analyzing clinical trials on ghrelin, leptin, ultra-processed cravings, and fat loss.

item.title: Fasting While Having Insulin Resistance May Not Be Such a Good Idea
item.description: Why fasting with insulin resistance may not yield expected fat loss. Exploring chronic hyperinsulinemia, muscle catabolism, and circadian feeding.

item.title: Intermittent Fasting Isn't Working for You? Your Gut Microbiome Might Be the Reason
item.description: Strict intermittent fasting not yielding results? Emerging research shows gut microbiome composition and Akkermansia levels dictate metabolic response.

item.title: Your Diet May Be Epigenetically Programming Your Liver for Cancer Years in Advance
item.description: Years of high-fat nutrition can epigenetically reprogram liver cells long before tumors appear. Discover how diet alters chromatin and cancer risk.

item.title: Can Nutrients Naturally Stimulate GLP-1? The Science of Dietary Incretin Secretion
item.description: Can nutrients naturally stimulate GLP-1? We explore the physiology of dietary fiber, protein, and gut L-cells in triggering natural incretin secretion.

item.title: There Is a Subset of Patients Resistant to GLP-1 Therapies: Why Do Some Not Respond?
item.description: Why do some patients fail to lose weight on GLP-1 therapies? We examine non-responder phenotypes, genetic polymorphisms, and resistance mechanisms.

item.title: How Does a Blood Sugar-Raising Hormone Promote Weight Loss? The Paradox of Glucagon
item.description: How does glucagon, a blood sugar-raising hormone, induce weight loss? Unpacking the glucagon paradox and next-generation tri-agonists like retatrutide.

item.title: The GLP-1 Exit Strategy: What Actually Happens When You Discontinue Incretin Therapy?
item.description: What happens when you discontinue GLP-1 incretin therapy? Evidence on metabolic adaptation, weight regain, and clinical maintenance exit strategies.

item.title: The Muscle Mass Panic with GLP-1: Are We Losing Muscle or Shrinking Overall Body Mass?
item.description: Is muscle loss on GLP-1 agonists cause for panic? Reviewing DEXA body composition data, lean mass ratios, and dietary protein intake strategies.

item.title: GLP-1 Agonists: Is Weight Loss the Same as Truly Treating the Disease of Obesity?
item.description: Do GLP-1 receptor agonists truly treat obesity as a chronic disease or just reduce body mass? A critical review of EASO guidelines and adipose health.

item.title: Feeling Full on GLP-1 Doesn't Change the Fact That Your Cells Might Be Starving
item.description: Suppressed appetite on GLP-1 does not mean your cells are nourished. Learn why hidden malnutrition and micronutrient deficiencies emerge during therapy.
